title: Academic 01 and General Training 01 — written form review blueprint

notes: Human teacher review and reviewer identity pending; manifest entries do not imply approval.

listening.timingPolicy: Verify actual audio sequence including preparation/checking pauses; do not mechanically pad a short script or count the final checking interval twice.
listening.audioGate: Scripts are reviewable text, not playable Listening. Generate/record permitted original voices, verify every word/key/timecode, audition full files and test delivery before availability.

academicReading.wordCountConvention: Stimulus text only; document headings/prompt exclusions.
academicReading.construct: Non-specialist descriptive/narrative/argumentative texts including detailed logical argument.

generalTrainingReading.section1: Two/three short or several shorter everyday texts.
generalTrainingReading.section3: One longer general-interest text; increasing difficulty across sections.

writing.generalTask1: Letter with purpose, audience and three requested points; appropriate tone.
writing.task2: Relevant developed argument addressing every demand.
writing.scoring: Four equally weighted criteria within each task; qualitative review only in this edition.

speaking.interactionGate: Responsive approved interviewer and complete audio evidence required. Fixed questions alone are rehearsal.
speaking.scoring: Qualitative four-criterion review; no part-band arithmetic or text-only pronunciation judgement.

holdoutPolicy.crossFormExposure: Completing Academic 01 shared Listening/Speaking exposes those same sections for General Training 01; the second form is not independently unseen across all four skills.
holdoutPolicy.familyBoundary: Source-based families may overlap. Audit actual source semantic exposure across units/forms before any unseen admission; changed wording or fileID cannot create a fresh family.
holdoutPolicy.teacherPreview: Authorized teacher exposure is not learner exposure, but restricted content cannot enter learner/tutor retrieval.
holdoutPolicy.laterForms: A separate new family pool is required for repeated unseen progress evaluation; no equating claim.

releaseGates.evidence: Original complete stimuli, instructions, private keys/rationale or criterion analysis, coherent task assembly.
Actual approved audio; accessible verified visual/data assets; hashes/timecodes/full audition.
Server-authoritative full runner, one-play sequence, responsive Speaking, capture/recovery and timed synthetic administration.
Named IELTS reviewer decision on exact content/asset editions plus independent key solving.
Separate rater, held-out form/outcome and calibration work before any score prediction claim.

notes: Current directory name is historical Academic-first naming; these are separate Academic/General form blueprints.
Written form review is useful before audio production; it must never be presented as a completed playable full test.
No fixed estimated total is created by adding inconsistent official approximations; enforce component timing according to reviewed delivery policy.
Source-based reauthoring supersedes source-free written drafts. This blueprint specifies validity requirements, not demonstrated unseen/calibrated forms.

sourceCorrection.taskMapping: Each passage/part/task maps once to inspected selected sources.
sourceCorrection.exposure: Source-semantic overlap between teaching and mock invalidates a blanket unseen claim. Candidate forms need family audit before independent release.
